# IdeaSpark 3.0 Playbook

> IdeaSpark 3.0 is a two-day entrepreneurship ideathon on 5 and 6 October 2026 at Faraday Hall and Mini Hall 1, run by the Founders Club at SRM Institute of Science and Technology. Teams of 1 to 3 pitch and are evaluated on Day 1; the shortlisted Top 15 return for Triumph Talk XI and the Grand Final on Day 2.

## Playbook

- [Playbook](playbook.md): Dates, venue, tracks, the full two-day schedule, the Founder Simulation rules, the judging rubric out of 50, prizes, FAQ and contacts.
